gappers.catalyst: Q3 earnings miss (EPS $2.12 vs $3.02 est) and FCF deficit overshadow Google Cloud +103%.
headlines: Alphabet shares tumble as earnings miss overshadows cloud boom (Investing.com)
Alphabet tumbles as earnings miss overshadows Google Cloud surge (Seeking Alpha)
gappers.catalyst_detail: Q3 reported 10/28 after close. EPS $2.12 vs $3.02 consensus (adj $2.67), hurt by an $8.7B equity-securities loss. Revenue +25% to $127.6B, in line. Cloud revenue +103% to $30.71B beat, but search/ads missed and FCF turned to a $9.07B deficit. Capex guided to rise significantly in 2027.
gappers.why: Cash burn and capex ramp reignite AI-spend worries; ads miss removes the offset from Cloud strength.
gappers.impact: Premarket volume 718K and Nasdaq futures -1.1% on the name. Large-cap earnings gap-downs often continue on analyst downgrades, but Cloud beat may attract dip buyers. Read-through: AI/megacap tech sentiment.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Long-side catch-the-knife is weak vs rulebook (no confirmed reversal). Would use a slot of 6 and 1 of 3 weekly trades; a 10% trail stop is ~within gap range, so 2:1 R:R is doubtful until price stabilises.

gappers.catalyst: Investor Day: FY30 revenue target $225B and $20B cap on new funding.
headlines: Oracle shares jump as long-term outlook targets $225 billion in revenue (Investing.com)
Oracle jumps as company provides long-term guidance at analyst day (Seeking Alpha)
gappers.catalyst_detail: Oracle set FY30 revenue goal of at least $225B and capped new capital-market funding at $20B ($10B equity, $10B gross debt) through FY30. Reports place the main jump on 10/28 (~+9-11%), so the Alpaca gap vs prev_close may partly reflect that session's move rather than a fresh overnight gap. Stock is still ~-48% over 12 months.
gappers.why: Funding cap eases the debt/financing overhang while the revenue target restores growth narrative; short covering and analyst reiterations (Wells Fargo Overweight) add fuel.
gappers.impact: Volume 2.6M is strong. Move is a rebound within a long downtrend; follow-through uncertain after a two-day pop.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Structural guidance reset fits multi-week swing, but extended after a 1-2 day run. Would displace a weaker holding or GOOG idea; entry near highs makes 2:1 R:R at a 10% trail hard to clear.
